powershell: $t="E:\0apps\tools"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $t | Out-Null; $zip="$t\uv.zip"; & curl.exe -sS -L --http1.1 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 300 -o $zip "https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/latest/download/uv-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip" 2>&1 | Out-Null; "zip=" + (Get-Item $zip -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Length; try { Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $zip -DestinationPath $t -Force -ErrorAction Stop; "expanded" } catch { "expand_failed: " + $_.Exception.Message }; $uv = Get-ChildItem $t -Filter uv.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if($uv){ "uv_path=" + $uv.FullName; (& $uv.FullName --version) } else { "uv_missing" }
